## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly 2D fantasy adventure game with a controllable warrior, forest map, three enemies, sword combat, health, potions, random chest loot, inventory, touchscreen controls, and a victory condition.

## Requirements
- Player can move, attack, take damage, and collect items.
- Visible health bar.
- Three enemies that move and attack independently.
- Sword deals measurable damage.
- Healing potion restores health.
- Treasure chest contains a random reward.
- Simple inventory tracks collected items.
- Touchscreen controls for Android.
- Gameplay must function, not just be a visual demo.
- Victory condition when all three enemies are defeated.
- Prioritize functioning gameplay over graphics.
- Build immediately without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a vanilla Canvas 2D game with no external assets or build step, served as a static `index.html`.
- Used four classic scripts in order, relying on shared global lexical bindings: `js/core.js`, `js/logic.js`, `js/render-world.js`, `js/render-fx.js`, `js/main.js`.
- Procedural painterly forest map (1600×1200) with camera follow, culling, cached terrain, cached tree/rock/tent sprites, cached screen overlays, and fixed 60 Hz simulation timestep.
- Enemies: goblin (52 HP), wolf (46 HP), orc (112 HP), each with distinct speed, range, windup, cooldown, and AI states.
- Player starts with 1 potion; two potion pickups exist in the world.
- Chest gives one of five random rewards: gold, 2 potions, Silver Edge (+6 damage), Vitality Charm (+25 max HP), or Ancient Ruby (+60 gold).
- Start overlay has exactly one button labelled “Play” so the default capture auto-start can find it.
- Added `window.__hollowwood` debug API for state inspection and automated testing.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and all game scripts.
- Implemented movement (WASD/arrows + joystick), sword swings with auto-facing, arc hit detection, damage numbers, crits, knockback, particles, and camera shake.
- Implemented independent enemy patrol/chase/windup/strike/recover/goblin-retreat AI.
- Implemented player damage, invulnerability, death/game-over, potion use, potion pickups, gold drops, chest interaction, inventory UI, edge markers, and victory flow.
- Implemented responsive HUD, touch joystick, sword/heal/open buttons, start menu, victory overlay, defeat overlay, sound toggle, and WebAudio SFX.
- Added performance optimizations: fixed timestep, pixel budget, terrain cropping, culling, static sprites, cached screen overlays.
- Automated desktop test passed: start, movement, sword damage, enemy damage, potion, pickup, chest, all three kills, victory overlay, restart, mobile layout, touch joystick, touch sword.
- Server is running in tmux session `hollowwood` on `http://localhost:3000`.

### Active
- Final verification and cleanup of a harmless test assertion failure.
- The full test failed only at `assert.equal(await mobile.locator('#relic-list').isVisible(), true)` because `#relic-list` is correctly hidden while empty via CSS `:empty`.
- Need to replace that assertion with a check that the satchel/inventory is visible, then rerun the suite.

- (none)

1. Edit `/tmp/opencode/test-game.mjs` to assert `#hud` or `.satchel` visibility instead of `#relic-list`.
2. Rerun `cd /tmp/opencode && node test-game.mjs`.

5. Optionally update README with game description and controls; commit changes when satisfied.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, HUD, menus, result overlays, script order.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full responsive visual design and touch layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/core.js`: constants, utilities, sound, map layout, ground rendering, global `game` state.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/logic.js`: reset, movement, combat, enemy AI, chest, pickups, victory/death, camera.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render-world.js`: trees, characters, chest, static sprite preparation, culling, world drawables.

- `/tmp/opencode/test-load.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/test-fps.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/test-raf-parts2.mjs`: auxiliary load/performance tests.

## Hollowwood — A Forest Adventure

A small, self-contained 2D action-adventure built with vanilla Canvas and WebAudio. No build step or external assets required.

Three beasts have taken the glade. Play as a warrior, cut them down, loot the chest, and survive.

| Heal | Q | Heal button |

- Procedural forest with camera follow, culling, cached sprites, and a fixed-step simulation.

- `index.html` — page shell, HUD, menus, and overlays
- `styles.css` — responsive visual design and touch layout
- `js/core.js` — constants, state, map, terrain rendering, audio helpers
